titre: Date de la montée de version de la base : le ticket récent contredit le runbook et l'annonce, la réponse doit le dire

entree.question: When is the big database upgrade happening now? I need the maintenance window for the customer notice and the support macro.

faits.texte: Gives the current date: Saturday December 5, 02:00 to 05:00 UTC.
Says older sources (the Notion runbook and/or the #eng-announce message) still give November 21, and that this date is outdated.
Presents the December 5 date (Linear ticket of November 16) before the outdated November 21 date.
Says the customer notice (status page and in-app banner) is planned for Saturday November 28.
Says the upgrade was pushed back so as not to stack risk after the November 12 incident and before the Fernhill go-live on December 1.
Says dashboards will be read-only for about 40 minutes during the switch.
Mentions the staging rehearsal on Friday November 27.

interdits.texte: Gives November 21 as the current date of the upgrade.
Says the new date is still to be decided (true only after the November 12 meeting).
Says the customer notice goes out on November 14 (old plan).
Gives a date or window that appears nowhere, such as Sunday December 6 or a weekday evening.

pieges: Contradiction : le runbook Notion (jamais mis à jour) et l'annonce Slack disent 21 novembre, le ticket Linear du 16/11 dit 5 décembre ; le plus récent gagne et la contradiction doit être dite, le plus récent d'abord.
Périmé : la réunion du 12/11 dit « nouvelle date à proposer » ; elle est dépassée par le ticket.
Vocabulaire : « database upgrade », « maintenance window » au lieu de Postgres 17 / cutover.
